title: Apple Execs on What Went Wrong With Siri, iOS 26 and More (Full Interview) | WSJ
summary: WSJ's Joanna Stern interviews Apple's Craig Federighi and Greg Joswiak at WWDC 2025 about Siri's delays, AI strategy, the Liquid Glass redesign in iOS 26, iPad versus Mac, and tariffs.
why: Commenters cite it as a rare, pointed grilling of Apple executives over why Siri fell behind.

quote.text: This is a rare and fantastic grilling of Apple by a journalist over Siri, with Craig Federighi and Greg Joswiak. It's a masterpiece.
